definitions.explanation: A long, thin stick or pole used for various purposes — hanging laundry, pushing a boat, or reaching things. One of the basic tools in traditional Japanese daily life.
A rod used for fishing, especially a traditional bamboo fishing pole. In fishing contexts, 竿 alone commonly means 'fishing rod.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{物干|ものほ}し{竿|ざお}→物干し竿：08019_monohoshizao⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{干|ほ}す→干す：00115_hosu⟧。
examples.english: To hang laundry on a drying pole.
I knocked persimmons down with a long pole.

examples.japanese: ⟦{船頭|せんどう}→船頭：13986_sendou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{竿|さお}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{川底|かわぞこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{突|つ}いて→突く：12735_tsuku⟧⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めた→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: The boatman pushed the boat forward by poling the riverbed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{竿|さお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a new fishing rod.

examples.japanese: {竿|さお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{垂|た}れて→垂れる：10075_tareru⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: To drop the rod and wait for a bite.
My grandfather liked fishing with a bamboo rod.

notes:
A fundamental word in traditional Japanese life. The voiced form ざお appears in compounds: ⟦{物干|ものほ}し{竿|ざお}→物干し竿：08019_monohoshizao⟧ ('laundry pole'), ⟦{釣|つ}り{竿|ざお}→釣り竿：07331_tsurizao⟧ ('fishing rod'). Originally referred to bamboo poles, which were the standard material for centuries.

USAGE:
- In compound words, the reading changes to ざお through rendaku (sequential voicing): ⟦{釣|つ}り{竿|ざお}→釣り竿：07331_tsurizao⟧, ⟦{物干|ものほ}し{竿|ざお}→物干し竿：08019_monohoshizao⟧.
- {竿|さお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{差|さ}す→差す：17637_sasu⟧ ('to pole a boat') is the traditional expression for propelling a flat-bottomed boat.
- In everyday modern life, the most common encounter with {竿|さお} is the ⟦{物干|ものほ}し{竿|ざお}→物干し竿：08019_monohoshizao⟧ used to hang laundry outdoors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{物干|ものほ}し{竿|ざお}→物干し竿：08019_monohoshizao⟧: laundry drying pole
- ⟦{釣|つ}り{竿|ざお}→釣り竿：07331_tsurizao⟧: fishing rod
- {竿|さお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{差|さ}す→差す：17637_sasu⟧: to pole a boat
- {竿|さお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{垂|た}れる→垂れる：10075_tareru⟧: to cast a line (fishing)
- {竹|たけ}{竿|ざお}: bamboo pole

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{棒|ぼう}→棒：03726_bou⟧: stick; bar — a general term for a rigid stick or rod, without the long-and-thin connotation of {竿|さお}
- ⟦{杖|つえ}→杖：12862_tsue⟧: cane; walking stick — a stick used for support while walking
- ロッド: rod — the English loanword, used mainly for modern fishing rods
